note: Declared source-pixel sizes measured beside the standard size (human size rule 2026-10-23: rectangular 35x35 = 1225, Delaunay 1250). A size variant is the standard-size production cell (--standard-size) built at the declared count instead (--standard-size --source-pixels <n>); its rows live in the cell's source_pixels_<n>/ folder, are keyed on their own (regime source_pixels_<n>) and are current there beside the standard row, without a size_fallback note. Coverage and the trend dashboard stay standard-only. Read by _profile_cli.py (which counts --source-pixels may join --standard-size) and scripts/misc/tooling/catalogue_lifecycle.py (keys and status).

variants.reason: the rectangular mesh the SLaM inference runs use (mesh_shape 28x28 = 784; the standard-size production cell is otherwise unchanged: hst_rect_adapt 32x32 resized to 28x28 instead of 35x35), so the autolens_inference wall-time rows pair with a profiling runtime row of the same size (autolens_inference#47 size_match)
